node: Travel marketplace and hotel distribution tollbooths
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the travel marketplace / hotel-distribution tollbooth node. The reference lane is Booking Holdings as the global OTA marketplace benchmark and Expedia Group as a large-cap platform with a visible B2B travel-supply/API angle. The underfollowed lane is Sabre as a sub-USD-1B travel-distribution infrastructure company and Travelzoo as a speculative sub-USD-300M consumer-travel demand/channel-access asset. This pass intentionally avoids filling the list with mega-cap consumer platforms and instead flags smaller infrastructure or channel-access names where evidence must be verified in later layers. Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around travel distribution chokepoints rather than hotel ownership. The reference anchor is Booking Holdings as the obvious two-sided lodging marketplace. The underfollowed lane is concentrated in smaller travel infrastructure names: Sabre as a B2B travel marketplace/GDS and hotel B2B distribution provider after divesting Hospitality Solutions; Agilysys as hospitality operating software embedded inside hotels, resorts, casinos and cruise lines; and PROS as airline offer/pricing infrastructure that supports dynamic pricing, direct distribution and conversion across channels. These are not buy/sell recommendations. They are research candidates for later evidence testing around supplier density, switching costs, recurring revenue, take rate, customer concentration and travel-cycle sensitivity. Expanded the universe around travel marketplace and distribution tollbooths with one mega-cap reference anchor
